start.text:
Thank yah for everything yah've done for us, softshell. Everytime I see yah I just wanna hug yah! The moods of my people 'ave never been better.
Got anymore of our lost kin for us today?
start.choice: I think I found some eggs to give!

start.text: Another of our newfound kin, ready for a good hatchin'! I remember me' first hatchin.' Nursie' had to stop me from chokin' on me own egg-bits. Said she'd never seen a bugger do that--told me I'd be a special one just from that alone. To be honest, think the eggshells mighta jumbled me brain a bit. Did taste good though, yeah!~ Ah, another one, hm? Yah' know, I know you've probably had a hankerin' for tryin' one of these eggs. These ones are fertile, yeah? We abstain from eaten them. But amongst the hundreds our progenitor pushes out, she sometimes gets one or two that go dormant--they won't grow; stifled I guess. We often eat those if ye' wanna try it? Speak to Chymero in the midding living-qaurters! He'll sort you out!~ Sometimes, I'll sing to the younguns while they are still in their egglums. You can always tell the one's who's really lovin' it--they start twitchin' and squirmin' in their shell. Sometimes even on rhythm! It's something magical I tell yah.~ Did I evah tell yah how some domby dropped me while I was still in my egglin'? I went rollin' down into the very pits of Rhemhex's darkest corridors. Was a lucky fool, even before hatchin', one of the arbiters came down and snatched me up despite the dangers lurkin' in there! Sweetheart gave me a chance I woulda never thought of havin'. I've decided to make the best of it.~
start.choice: This eggs a lil' bizarre compared to the rest, but I believe its yours!
This egg is hard, and shines with a wonderful chrome color, here!
This egg truly beckons the eater's majesty, here!
This egg has touched other realms, the rarest of its kind!

start.text: I think yah' did it, the nobles can't keep ye' name out their mouths! They seem receptive and want to meet'cha, are ye' ready to enter the city?
Ya've done so much for us already, I feel strange saying that the nobles aren't convinced yet-- but keep at it! They've got to warm up to yah if bring some more!
Oi, whu'tcha got for us, friend?
start.choice: I think I found some eggs to give!

node.text: Yeah, show me what you 'ave', you'll be compensated, promise!
node.choice: Here's an egg I found!
This eggs a lil' bizarre compared to the rest, but I believe its yours!
I found a vibrant ruby-egg!
I found a calming sapphire-egg!
I found a glowing jade-egg!
This egg is hard, and shines with a wonderful chrome color, here!
This egg truly beckons the eater's majesty, here!
This egg has touched other realms, the rarest of its kind, I give it to you!

node.text:
Yep, the grand shah has also showed interest in yah, friend, a rare thing indeed. I think she 'as something for ye--and a request! It's an honor to meet our progenitor. She is very wise, very old. Heh, like *old*, yah? I think you'll love her--sweet ol' mama'vibes. Acceptin' and lovin' in everyway.
She'll treat ye' like you're her kid, regardless if yah popped out 'er ovipositor or not.
node.choice: I'll go to meet her then, live and drink, friend.

node.text: Also, there are plenty of our buglin's still out there, yeah? Feel free to keep bringin' 'em to me, and I'll reward ye' proper still regardless, mkay? You might find me inside now, standin' out in this stale air will make a bugger's chitin all slicky!
node.choice: I'll keep my eyes open!

start.text: Oh! You're back, wonderluster! It's good to know you're safe, what brings you 'ere?
start.choice: I'm curious what this place is!

start.text:
{{yellow|*They squint in disbelief*}}
By my shaky chitin-molts, look at this! Me' first gaze at an outsider in over six decades--a wanderer, nay wanderluster, even?
Say, you've been about--you've must of met a salthoppah or two, yeah?
Tell me, don't you find their coxa quite ... stimulatin'? I just can't help to gander when I catch one struttin' n thrippin' an' hoppin' about.
start.choice: Hm, coxa do look quite stimulating, sure.

node.choice: Um. Thanks? Live and Drink."
Um. Thanks? What is this place, anyway.

node.text:
Fair enough, softshell. But tell me, why yah' bumblin' about here in the crystholts?
Bevidd is a dangerous place, friend. End up a morbid bauble near a pond of pretty-water if ye' ain't careful.
node.choice: Wandering, mostly. Can I enter the city for respite?
I'll keep that to myself, live and drink well.

node.text:
Ah, well It's that strong, robust--utterly tantalizing segmenta just before their trochanter, wonderfully swollen with muscly tendons and -- ...
Oi, yah know what. I should stop. I'm just makin' things wierd.
Anyways, what brings yah'ere, friend? Bevidd isn't exactly a spot for recess.
node.choice: Yeah, you ARE wierd. Live and drink.
Wandering these strange lands. May I enter your city for rest?

node.text:
Ah, t'is the wonderful lil' city of Rhemhez'Qen, friend. Why ya' bumblin' about here in the crystholts?
Bevidd is a dangerous place, friend. End up a morbid babble near a pond of pretty-water if ye' ain't careful.
node.choice: Venturing, mostly. May I enter your city?

node.text:
Aye, I'd love to show ye' our wonderful city. But, unfortunately, there's been a bit of a problem, see.
A thief has broken into our egg chambers, the little piss-face. Stole batches of our great shah's progeny and used some kind of ancient tech' to 'ave it all stripped from us in mass.
We sent out some of our strongest to search for our missin' buglin's, but with them softskinned tin-heads lurking around every corner, we can't empty our reserves. They've been plottin' attacks on the Grand Shah for ages now.
node.choice: Tin-heads? Wait, you mean the Templar?
Maybe I can help? An egg-hunt sounds fun.

node.text:
Yep, them Templar foolies seem intent on gettin' in. They got bad history with our queen. Assassination attempts, attacks on our people, they aren't the only enemies we 'ave, but we got a sore-spot for 'em that's for sure!
Give em' a good knockin' for me if yah see them, yeah?
node.choice: Of course, I'll give em worse than that. Do you need help finding your eggs? Maybe I can assist?

node.text: Ye'd do that for us? I mean, I thought it was a hopeless gambit to be honest but--if ye can bring enough of our childre' back, I could convince our most esteemed to let ya' in!
node.choice: Sure, where do I bring them, friend?

node.text: Me! Just bring any of our eggs yah find out there to me, and I'll let our nobles know of ye' exploits to help us! They'll of course also have their own lil' ways of payin' yah back--Water, ancient baubles, rare stones--you get the jist, yeah?
node.choice: Got it, off to do an egg-hunt, live and drink friend!
